parsed.notes: Leverage Ratio is debt-to-capitalization (total indebtedness / (indebtedness + tangible net worth)), not a debt/EBITDA multiple, so classified as 'other'. Company must meet either the Interest Coverage Ratio or minimum liquidity test, not both. Minimum liquidity values are in $ millions. Covenants are shared by the $1.20 billion Credit Facility and $360.0 million Term Loan. Other covenant tests in the table (tangible net worth > $2.82 billion vs $3.76 billion actual; JV investments < $856.9 million vs $472.0 million; borrowing base excess $2.07 billion) are dollar-amount tests, not ratios, and are omitted. Leverage-based pricing spreads and commitment fees were excluded. Company reported compliance as of August 31, 2026.
